title: Thai-Style Meat Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired wrap filled with marinated meat and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Kissed meat marinade
ingredients.notes: marinade ingredients: 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp brown sugar, 1 tsp grated ginger

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Marinate the fatty meat for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the meat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to a safe internal temperature of 63°C (145°F).
Warm the Syrian wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by slicing the grilled meat, adding vegetables and your favorite Thai-inspired sauce.
